name: Agnaktor Scale
description: A scale so bright that it looks like it's on fire. Not worth very much, though.

name: Agnaktor Carapace
description: Sturdier and more heat-resistant than the Shell. It produces a vivid red color when crafted.

name: Agnaktor Hide+
description: Precious, high-quality Agnaktor hide tempered by frequent exposure to magma.

name: Agnaktor Claw+
description: A claw sharpened by magma so hot it can melt rock. Almost as strong as a volcano itself.

name: Agnaktor Fin+
description: An Agnaktor fin with an elegant dappled pattern. Apparently a popular item with collectors.

name: Agnaktor Beak
description: An Agnaktor's distinguishing beak, which allows it to tunnel beneath the earth.

name: Agnaktor Tail
description: A tail carved from an Agnaktor. The going price is low due to lack of demand.

name: Scalding Pleura+
description: A chestplate made from ore fusing together over a number of years. Won't melt, despite the heat.

name: Hyper Agnaktor Shell
description: Darker than normal Agnaktor shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Wyvern Crystal
description: A mysterious crystal that glows with the energy of both light and dark spirits.

name: Akantor Scale+
description: Faintly glittering Akantor Scale. It will not melt, even if dipped in lava.

name: Akantor Carapace
description: Shining Akantor Shell. Exceptionally hard, and thus difficult to craft.

name: Akantor Tail
description: The large rock-like tail of an Akantor. Strong enough to gouge the earth.

name: Akantor Hardclaw
description: Hard Akantor claw that can smash bedrock. Its victims are left unrecognizable.

name: Akantor Tallfang
description: Huge fang that can pierce the heavens. It has passed through many foes.

name: Akantor Spike
description: A flawless spike from an Akantor. It can easily scar rock.

name: Akantor Gem
description: A gem that once belonged to the Ancient World-King. Its aura resists new ownership.

name: Arzuros Pelt
description: A pelt carved from an Arzuros. The white portion is soft, while the blue is short and taut.

name: Arzuros Pelt+
description: A splendid Arzuros pelt. Sturdy enough to survive in harsh mountainous terrain

name: Arzuros Shell
description: A shell of piece from an Arzuro's head or back. Bends willingly and is easy to forge.

name: Arzuros Carapace
description: A quality Arzuros carapace. The thick shell can withstand bites from ordinary fangs.

name: Arzuros Brace
description: A brace from an Arzuro's foreleg. Its sharp portions give forged equipment a wild flavor.

name: Arzuros Brace+
description: A strong Arzuros brace. Its thorn-like protrusions make paw swipes deadly.

name: Redhelm Pelt
description: A pelt hard enough to pierce flesh. Its looks embody the Redhelm Arzuros's brutality.

name: Redhelm Pelt+
description: A quality pelt that's hard and durable. Epitomizes the Redhelm's viciousness.

name: Redhelm Shell
description: A shell from a Redhelm Arzuros. Even its hard and sturdy shell looks fierce.

name: Redhelm Carapace
description: A superior Redhelm Arzuros scale. Even its thick and sturdy shell looks ferocious.

name: Redhelm Ragehair
description: The hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros. Its looks befit the beast's wild nature.

name: Redhelm Furyhair
description: High quality hair from the head of a Redhelm Arzuros that embodies its ferocity.

name: Astalos Scale
description: An Astalos scale that reflects sunlight, giving it a rainbow-like appearance.

name: Astalos Scale+
description: A quality scale carved from an Astalos. Looks tough, but is actually quite flexible.

name: Astalos Shell
description: The spiny shell of an Astalos that covers it like armor. Try to keep a safe distance.

name: Astalos Shell+
description: An Astalos's tough, spiny shell. Hard and sharp, it's a favored material for armor.

name: Astalos Membrane
description: An Astalos wing membrane. It glows when exposed to electricity. Thin but tough.

name: Astalos Membrane+
description: Quality Astalos wing membrane. Pulses green and continues to conduct electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon
description: An Astalos wingtalon. Black, but turns green when exposed to electricity.

name: Astalos Wingtalon+
description: A sharp Astalos wingtalon, capable of cutting through its prey in one fell swoop.

name: Astalos Crest
description: Conductive material can be harvested from an Astalos's head when it's threatened.

name: Astalos Crest+
description: A highly conductive material pulsing with electricity that is harvested from an Astalos.

name: Astalos Scissortail
description: The scissors-shaped tail of an Astalos. It's able to store large amounts of electricity.

name: Electroscale
description: Highly conductive scale from an Astalos. Its unique shape is hard to work with.

name: Electroscale+
description: An Astalos scale that generates electricity, even after being separated from its body.

name: Astalos Plate
description: A scale carved from an Astalos. It glows a bright green and is very rare.

name: Astalos Electrogem
description: A brilliant green gem found inside an Astalos. It pulsates with an intense energy.

name: Hyper Astalos Scale
description: Darker than normal Astalos scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Blangonga Pelt
description: White fur with astounding thermal properties and as strong as an iron chain.

name: Blangonga Pelt+
description: The hardened pelt of a Blangonga. The needle-like hairs are prized material.

name: Blangonga Fang
description: The fang of the killer Blangonga. As sharp and deadly as a dagger.

name: Blangonga Fang+
description: A Blangonga dogtooth. As large as a human thigh, it has potential as a weapon.

name: Blangonga Whisker
description: A fine hair that sprouted from the face of a Blangonga troop leader.

name: Blangonga Tail
description: The smooth feeling of a Blangonga Tail is undeniably appealing.

name: Hyper Blangonga Pelt
description: Darker than normal Blangonga pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Brach Shell
description: A dark green Brachydios shell. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Carapace
description: A hard Brachydios carapace. Glossy like obsidian, it adds a refined beauty to crafted gear.

name: Brach Ebonshell
description: An obsidian Brachydios brace. Makes especially strong armor, perhaps due to the slime mold.

name: Brach Ebonshell+
description: An obsidian shell from the foreleg. It has evolved to withstand slime blasts.

name: Brach Scalp
description: The large, protruding scalp of a Brachydios, covered in an explosive green substance.

name: Brach Scalp+
description: A hard and sharp scalp piece from a fierce Brachydios. Even more explosive than usual.

name: Mystery Slime
description: The explosive green substance found on Brachydios monsters. Handle with extreme care.

name: Brach Hammer
description: An arm that has crushed the courage out of many a hunter. Slime makes forging tricky.

name: Brach Pounder
description: A Brachydios arm that buried countless foolhardy hunters. It's covered in green slime.

name: Brach Tail
description: While most focus on Brachydios's arms, its tail is also strong. Beware the explosive slime!

name: Brach Marrow
description: Stickier than normal marrow. A top-class welding material, if you're in the market.

name: Brach Gem
description: A rare gem from a Brachydios. Perhaps the secret of its dreadful slime is hidden inside?

name: Hyper Brach Shell
description: Darker than normal Brachydios shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Bulldrome Hide
description: The hide of a Bulldrome. Its bristliness has a certain beauty to it.

name: Bulldrome Hide+
description: The tough, unblemished hide of a Bulldrome.

name: Bulldrome Tusk
description: A majestic Bulldrome Tusk. The damaged surface tells the tale of many battles.

name: Bulldrome Tusk+
description: The large tusk of a majestic Bulldrome. It has been hardened through battle.

name: Cephalos Scale
description: A sand wyvern scale. Its color is a brilliant blue. Retains moisture.

name: Cephalos Scale+
description: High-quality sand wyvern scale. It absorbs moisture, leaving it glowing blue.

name: Cephalos Fin
description: A sand wyvern fin. It isn't poisonous, but it's very sharp.

name: Cephalos Fin+
description: A quality fin that is sharper than other comparable samples.

name: Cephalos Fang
description: The fang of a Cephalos, which are known for their rows of jagged and razor-sharp teeth.

name: Cephalos Fang+
description: A sharp row of teeth made for sinking deep into prey.

name: Wyvern Scalp
description: A Carapaceon shell made from a wyvern's skull.

name: Black Pearl
description: A pearl with a black glow. Fetches a high price.

name: Decayed Crimson Horn
description: A red horn from a shelled monster. Despite the decay, it remains extremely durable.

name: Hermitaur Shell
description: A large piece of exoskeleton that's surprisingly light and easy to use in crafting.

name: Hermitaur Carapace
description: The hard carapace of a Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder than shell to work.

name: Hermitaur Claw
description: A giant claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. The sharp claw can slice through rock.

name: Hermitaur Claw+
description: Sharp claw from a Daimyo Hermitaur. As hard as metal.

name: Hyper Hermitaur Shell
description: Darker than normal Hermitaur scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Stonefist Shell
description: The shell from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Carapace
description: A hardened Stonefist Hermitaur shell. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw
description: A claw taken from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Stonefist Claw+
description: A sharp claw from a Stonefist Hermitaur. It has grown hard and dark over its many years.

name: Deviljho Scale
description: A greenish-black Deviljho scale. It's not often sold, as rumors claim it brings misfortune.

name: Deviljho Hide
description: Black hide that is oddly slimy and difficult to forge with.

name: Deviljho Tallfang
description: A large fang from a maw of alarming size. Helps the vile beast sate its hunger.

name: Deviljho Talon
description: A dangerously sharp, hooked talon. Inexperienced crafters risk serious injury.

name: Deviljho Scalp
description: Removing this part of a Deviljho's skull releases an unimaginably putrid odor.

name: Deviljho Tail
description: A massive tail resembling a giant leech. Some folks are out to collect these exclusively.

name: Deviljho Saliva
description: The symbol of a Deviljho's insatiable appetite. The strong acid corrodes all it touches.

name: Deviljho Gem
description: A precious gem said to contain a Deviljho's might. Used in shady rituals.

name: Hyper Deviljho Scale
description: Darker than normal Deviljho scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Black Blood
description: Dark black blood characteristic of a Deviljho. It feels like it may jump up and attack at any time.

name: Spattered Hide
description: A jet black hide with a slimy, tar-like sheen: dried blood spatter, some insist.

name: Duram Carapace
description: A stiff Duramboros carapace. It can withstand attacks like an impenetrable aegis.

name: Hard Mossplate
description: A shell covered in moss. Not only is it hard, the moss absorbs the shock of physical blows.

name: Duramboros Hump
description: The hump of a Duramboros's back. The fatty skin produces sturdy, pliable equipment when crafted.

name: Duram Tailcase+
description: A superior Duramboros tailcase. Slices and crushes using sharp shell and heavy bone.

name: Duramboros Horn+
description: A rigid Duramboros horn. Nothing in the world can stop it during a vicious charge.

name: Duram Sacrum
description: A striking Duramboros sacrum. Such tough, symmetrical bones are considered rare materials.

name: Hyper Duram Shell
description: Darker than normal Duramboros shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Gammoth Pelt
description: A pelt carved from a Gammoth. It's very durable as well as resistant to cold.

name: Gammoth Pelt+
description: A high-quality pelt from a Gammoth. It absorbs physical blows without losing durability.

name: Gammoth Shell
description: A shell from a Gammoth leg. It is designed to adhere to snow, and is utilized in armor joints.

name: Gammoth Carapace
description: An especially hard shell taken from a Gammoth leg. It's used to protect vulnerable areas.

name: Gammoth Fang
description: A large fang taken from a Gammoth. Valued for being tough, yet still pliable.

name: Gammoth Fang+
description: An extremely hard and tough Gammoth fang. Difficult to work with, but versatile.

name: Trunkspine
description: A spine taken from the trunk of a Gammoth. Strong enough to pierce the ground.

name: Gammoth Redfur
description: Thick fur made of hard, red hair taken from the lengthy mane of a Gammoth.

name: Snowclod
description: A clump of snow hardened by the material secreted from a Gammoth's leg.

name: Large Snowclod
description: A large clump of snow stuck to a Gammoth's leg. It is very hard and doesn't melt easily.

name: Gammoth Scalp
description: A shell from a Gammoth's head. Difficult to work with, but worth the effort.

name: Gammoth Ice Orb
description: A gem from inside a Gammoth. Named for its ice-like clarity and being as shiny as a jewel.

name: Hyper Gammoth Pelt
description: Darker than normal Gammoth fur, this Hyper fur emits an ominous glow.

name: Gendrome Hide
description: Sturdy green hide from a Gendrome. Perfect for making strong armor.

name: Gendrome Hide+
description: A high-quality green hide from a Gendrome. The hides of leaders are especially tough.

name: Gendrome Fang
description: The large and developed fang of a Gendrome. Be careful of its powerful neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Fang+
description: The large and sharpened fang of a Gendrome. Its tip excretes a deadly neurotoxin.

name: Gendrome Head
description: The head of a Gendrome. Noted for its two crests.

name: Bird Wyvern Gem
description: A valuable gem that can be harvested from Jaggi and other bird wyverns.

name: Glavenus Scale
description: A Glavenus scale. Along with the shell, they cover its body's vulnerable parts.

name: Glavenus Scale+
description: A quality scale taken from a Glavenus. It possesses excellent heat and damage resistance.

name: Glavenus Shell
description: A shell covering the entire body of a Glavenus. It easily deflects all but the strongest blows.

name: Glavenus Carapace
description: The hard shell of a Glavenus. It has been tempered many times due to its high body heat.

name: Glavenus Fang
description: A fang from a Glavenus. Razor sharp, it makes a formidable weapon.

name: Glavenus Fang+
description: Durable enough to withstand the jaws of a Glavenus's pressure, this fang can cut through anything.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell
description: A shell that resembles flickering flames. Its heat resistance is quite high.

name: Glavenus Pyroshell+
description: A shell that looks like a raging inferno. The constant heat makes it hard to work with.

name: Glavenus Tail
description: The tailblade of a Glavenus. Constant heating and cooling have forged a sturdy blade.

name: Glavenus Tailpiece
description: A detached piece of a Glavenus tail. Only a piece, but it'll still cut through most swords.

name: Flaming Bursa
description: A furnace-like organ located in the throat. It enables the beast to breathe red-hot magma.

name: Solar Bursa
description: A highly developed flaming bursa. Cotton-thin, but can resist even white-hot magma.

name: Glavenus Plate
description: A sharp scale that grows near the Glavenus's tail, it has the same role -- a short blade.

name: Glavenus Fire Orb
description: A red orb that grows within a flaming bursa. One peek can set even your soul aflame.

name: Hyper Glavenus Scale
description: Darker than normal Glavenus scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Hellblade Scale
description: A Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Scale+
description: A superior Hellblade Glavenus scale. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Shell
description: A shell taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Carapace
description: A hard Hellblade Glavenus shell. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Hellblade Powder
description: Powder taken from a Hellblade Glavenus. Explodes violently if not handled with care.

name: Gore Magala Scale
description: A black scale artisans fear because of the ill fortune said to surround it.

name: Gore Magala Scale+
description: A deep black scale that seems to devour surrounding light, not reflect it.

name: Gore Magala Shell
description: The Gore Magala's outer shell, said to eat the flesh of half-hearted attackers.

name: Gore Magala Carapace
description: The Gore Magala's handsome black suit of armor, said to negate all blows.

name: Gore Magala Wing
description: A writhing, jet black flight organ almost too hideous to be called a "wing".

name: Gore Magala Wing+
description: A horrifying wing that casts a hungry shadow over prey and drives them insane.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw
description: A menacing claw that carves beautiful, indelible curves through soft, pink flesh.

name: Gore Magala Ripclaw+
description: A claw from a third foreleg that inflicts Frenzy and generations of suffering.

name: Gore Magala Tail
description: A plient tail covered in reverse scales that strikes like a whip, not a blade.

name: Gore Magala Plate
description: Plating from the wing-limbs of the Gore Magala. Hunger and madness deepen the hue.

name: Gore Magala Nyctgem
description: A pure, dark jewel that imprisons and then destroys all nearby light.

name: Gore Magala Feeler
description: The Gore Magala's versatile sensory organ and lifeline. It serves many purposes.

name: Gore Magala Feeler+
description: A well-honed sensory organ that oozes violet melancholy from its infected tip.

name: Defiled Scale
description: A Frenzy-infested scale with patches of sickly color that make for a dangerous weapon.

name: Hyper G. Magala Scale
description: Darker than normal Gore Magala scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Great Maccao Scale
description: A scale that gets stronger when struck. Scales from the hands and feet are especially tough.

name: Great Maccao Scale+
description: A superior Great Maccao scale. The rarer, yellow scales are often used as decorations.

name: Great Maccao Hide
description: The braver the specimen, the duller and stronger this red hide becomes. Highly prized.

name: Great Maccao Hide+
description: Top-grade red Great Maccao hide. It is valued for its scars, and is used to reward valor.

name: Champion's Crest
description: Maccao males have decorative feathers, whose beauty is directly related to strength.

name: Maccao Tailspike
description: Extremely hard, it provides balance, gripping the ground like claws.

name: Rubbery Hide
description: Highly elastic Gypceros hide. A good insulator, resistant to electricity.

name: Rubbery Hide+
description: High-quality, highly elastic Gypceros hide. Gives off a strange scent.

name: Gypceros Webbing
description: Webbing from a Gypceros wing. A good insulator, it is also resistant to poison.

name: Gypceros Head
description: The uniquely shaped head of a Gypceros. A must have for Gypceros lovers!

name: Hyper Gypceros Hide
description: Darker than normal Gypceros hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Iodrome Hide
description: Sturdy red hide from an Iodrome. Perfect for making strong armor.

name: Iodrome Hide+
description: Sturdy red hide from an Iodrome. Perfect for making strong armor.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale
description: A violet scale carved from an Iodrome. It is more difficult to obtain than regular scales.

name: Iodrome Violet Scale+
description: A quality violet Iodrome scale. Its deep color borders on black--a sign of its quality.

name: Iodrome Head
description: An Iodrome head with a large, eye-catching crest.

name: Bird Wyvern Gem
description: A valuable gem that can be harvested from Jaggi and other bird wyverns.

name: Kecha Pelt+
description: A quality Kecha Wacha pelt that manages to be durable, yet still soft to the touch.

name: Kecha Grandbone
description: A quality, hardened arm bone that makes excellent armor in a gifted forger's hands.

name: Kecha Talon
description: A thick, sharp talon that evolved for climbing up ivy.

name: Kecha Ear+
description: The unmistakable, ocellated ear of a Kecha Wacha. Larger spots fetch a higher price.

name: Kecha Tail
description: A tail with soft strands of hair. It feels wonderful to the touch.

name: Hyper Kecha Wacha Pelt
description: Darker than normal Kecha pelt, this Hyper pelt emits an ominous glow.

name: Flabby Hide
description: Finally useable as a material thanks to recent advances. Has mysterious properties.

name: Pearl Hide
description: The hide of a Khezu. Its strange properties are still not fully understood.

name: Pale Bone
description: The rib bone from a Khezu. Still has chunks of meat attached.

name: Pale Steak
description: Fatty meat from a Pale Khezu. Looks tasty, but cannot be eaten.

name: Wyvern Gem
description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

name: Hyper Khezu Hide
description: Darker than normal Khezu hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Lagiacrus Hide
description: Not especially durable, but soft and workable. Use it to forge valuable leatherware.

name: Lagiacrus Hide+
description: A fine hide taken from a Lagiacrus. It's quite strong and immensely flexible.

name: Lagiacrus Scale
description: A supple scale that turns myriad shades of blue in the light. In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Scale+
description: A fine example of a supple Lagiacrus Scale. Its beauty is truly breathtaking.

name: Shell Shocker
description: This shell is actually used to release electricity, not generate it. Safe to handle.

name: Shell Shocker+
description: A superior shell found only on certain Lagiacrus. Its structure permits greater electric output.

name: Lagiacrus Horn
description: The power of Lagiacrus horns has been sung of for ages. In high demand.

name: Lagiacrus Horn+
description: A fine horn taken from a strong Lagiacrus. A horn like this is sure to catch people's attention.

name: Lagiacrus Tail
description: Not only do these serve for weaponcraft, they also wind up on Moga dinner plates.

name: Lagiacrus Claw
description: A sharp claw that grows on the fin. Not pretty enough to command good money.

name: Lagiacrus Claw+
description: A very sharp claw found on certain Lagiacrus. Its mundane appearance belies its strength.

name: Lagiacrus Plate
description: The largest and most prized of Lagiacrus scales. Boosts the efficacy of equipment.

name: Lagiacrus Sapphire
description: A gem only rarely plucked from a Lagiacrus. Craft with it to boost Resistances.

name: Hyper Lagiacrus Hide
description: Darker than normal Lagiacrus hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Lagombi Pelt
description: A white pelt carved from a Lagombi. One touch and you'll be hooked on its soft, fluffy fur.

name: Lagombi Pelt+
description: A quality white Lagombi pelt. Its glossy, frosty shine makes it a sought-after luxury item.

name: Lagombi Ear
description: The long ear of a Lagombi. A lifetime in frigid environments has made it hard as a shell.

name: Lagombi Ear+
description: An impressive Lagombi ear. Highly-developed, it can become sharp as steel if polished.

name: Lagombi Plastron
description: A shell piece from a Lagombi's belly. Its ridges are what allow the Lagombi to slide on ice.

name: Lagombi Plastron+
description: A strong, sticky, and thick Lagombi Plastron. Used to make superior equipment.

name: Lagombi Iceclaw
description: A Lagombi claw that's cold to the touch. Permanently covered in ice from a frigid climate.

name: Lagombi Frozenclaw
description: A Lagombi claw surrounded by cold air. Wounds it causes freeze over in an instant.

name: Snowbaron Pelt
description: A pelt that was carved from a Snowbaron Lagombi. It looks fluffy and is soft to the touch.

name: Snowbaron Pelt+
description: A hardened pelt taken from a Snowbaron Lagombi. Although stiff, it has a pleasing feel to it.

name: Snowbaron Plastron
description: A shell piece from a Snowbaron Lagombi's belly. It is known for its deep ridges.

name: Snowbaron Plastron+
description: A high-quality Snowbaron Lagombi plastron. Its deep ridges give it a nice shape.

name: Lavasioth Scale+
description: A superior Lavasioth scale. The encrusted lava leaves behind a brilliant gold sheen.

name: Lavasioth Carapace
description: Lavasioth carapace encrusted with rare hardened minerals, making for excellent armor.

name: Lavasioth Fang+
description: A sharp fang from a Lavasioth. Its size is unusual for a Piscine Wyvern.

name: Lavasioth Fin+
description: A high-quality fin that has been sharpened into a virtual weapon due to the lava's heat.

name: Hyper Lavasioth Scale
description: Darker than normal Lavasioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Azurefeather
description: The blue scalefeather of a Malfestio, the secret behind its silent flight.

name: Azurefeather+
description: A high-quality Malfestio scalefeather. Used in clothing as well as armor.

name: Malfestio Webbing
description: Webbing from a Malfestio wing. Its scales gather sound and emit a strange echo pattern.

name: Malfestio Wing
description: The deep blue wing of a Malfestio. Widely known for its beautiful curves.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon
description: A hard talon found at the end of a Malfestio wing. It's as sharp as a sword.

name: Malfestio Wingtalon+
description: A high-quality talon from a Malfestio wing. Hard and sharp, it's difficult to work with.

name: Malfestio Ear
description: The ear of a Malfestio. Smooth to the touch, it's quite muscular due to its constant movement.

name: Malfestio Tailfeather
description: The flamboyant tail feather of a Malfestio. Its color gradually changes from blue to gold.

name: Malfestio Goldfeather
description: The magnificent golden feather of a Malfestio. Collectors prize it for its sense of flair.

name: Hyper Azurefeather
description: Darker than normal Malfestio scalefeathers, it emits an ominous glow.

name: Najarala Shell
description: A shell that grows both large and small -- whatever won't impede movement.

name: Najarala Carapace
description: A long shell that covers the Najarala and may have evolved from a scale.

name: Najarala Hide
description: Comparatively flexible hide found under the shell and on the underbelly.

name: Najarala Hide+
description: A fine, silky-smooth hide that sells well at market as a top-class material.

name: Najarala Marrow
description: Marrow known to cause paralysis if handled improperly.

name: Najarala Medulla
description: A mass of tissue used as a coagulant in all manner of crafts.

name: Najarala Sounder
description: A Najarala shell with unique acoustic properties that amplify sound.

name: Najarala Sounder+
description: A shell with unique acoustic properties. Fragile and a real challenge to work with.

name: Najarala Fang
description: A fang containing an organ that induces neurogenic paralysis.

name: Chilling Beak
description: The Najarala's bird-like beak, which it uses to instantaneously seize prey.

name: Wyvern Gem
description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

name: Hyper Najarala Shell
description: Darker than normal Najarala shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Nargacuga Scale
description: A scale from a Nargacuga. The surface is covered with the beast's black fur.

name: Nargacuga Scale+
description: A black Nargacuga scale. Despite its hardness, it's surprisingly light and smooth.

name: Nargacuga Blackfur
description: Black fur that grows on scales. Covers the animal in jet-black darkness.

name: Nargacuga Pelt+
description: Pitch-black fur from a Nargacuga. It absorbs all light and emits pure darkness.

name: Nargacuga Tail
description: A Nargacuga's impressive tail. Might be mistaken for a weapon if seen out of context.

name: Narga Tailspike
description: A spiky scale from a Nargacuga tail. It stands up when the beast is enraged.

name: Nargacuga Cutwing
description: Blade-like Nargacuga wing. Evolved to cut down prey on the fly.

name: Narga Razor
description: The large, sharp bladewing of a Nargacuga. It can slice through foes in a flash.

name: Nargacuga Fang
description: Although small, the jagged placement of these fangs increase their cutting ability.

name: Nargacuga Fang+
description: A Nargacuga's incredibly sharp fang. Evolved to tear rather than chew.

name: Nargacuga Marrow
description: Marrow as nimble as the Nargacuga itself; requires talent to properly harvest.

name: Narga Medulla

name: Hyper Narga Scale

name: Silverwind Scale

name: Silverwind Blackfur

name: Silverwind Pelt+
description: Quality fur from a Silverwind Nargacuga. Its lightness allows swift and free movement.

name: Nibelsnarf Shell
description: A shell piece from a Nibelsnarf. Its great strength and hornlike bulges produce unique gear.

name: Nibelsnarf Carapace
description: A rigid Nibelsnarf carapace. Hard to forge, but the resulting equipment is worth the effort.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide
description: Hide from a Nibelsnarf. Many are surprised by its bright colors, in contrast to the outer shell.

name: Nibelsnarf Hide+
description: Quality Nibelsnarf hide often used as lining for armor. Strong enough to withstand the desert.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw
description: Nibelsnarf claws have evolved to be able to quickly and easily burrow through desert sand.

name: Nibelsnarf Claw+
description: A bold, firm Nibelsnarf claw. Ideal as material for crafting superior equipment parts.

name: Nibelsnarf Scalp
description: A part of the skull that holds various organs. The useful bits must be cut out carefully.

name: Vivid Fluid

name: Brilliant Fluid
description: A fluid with strong water-retention ability. Improves equipment performance.

name: Hyper Nibelsnarf Shell

name: Plesioth Scale+

name: Plesioth Fin+

name: Plesioth Fang+
description: A finely honed Plesioth Fang. Sharp enough to shatter the shells of small Carapaceons.

name: Plesioth Webbing
description: Difficult to forge with, but its water-retention properties make it popular as armor lining.

name: Plesioth Head
description: A surprisingly hard head prized as armor material. Might make for a great party gag, too.

name: Hyper Plesioth Scale
description: Darker than normal Plesioth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Rajang Horn+
description: The majestic golden horn of a Rajang. Hunters yearn for the heroism it represents.

name: Rajang Fang+
description: This sharpened fang can cut through anything dumb enough to touch it.

name: Rajang Blackfur
description: Black Rajang fur. When crafted, the resulting fabric is desired even by royalty.

name: Rajang Claw+

name: Rajang Nerve

name: Ghoulish Gold Horn
description: The golden horn of a furious Rajang. It seems almost too lovely to waste on equipment.

name: Rathalos Scale+
description: An extraordinarily durable scale carved from the body of a Rathalos.

name: Rathalos Shell

name: Rathalos Carapace

name: Rathalos Tail

name: Rathalos Ruby

description: Only recently extractable thanks to advances in carving techniques. Difficult to process.

name: Hyper Rathalos Scale

description: A sturdy Rathian carapace. Even harder than a normal Rathian Shell.

description: This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

name: Rathian Spike

description: As sharp as the keenest blade. It is longer and sturdier than other spikes.

name: Dreadqueen Scale+

description: A Dreadqueen Rathian shell. Its deadly poison makes it too dangerous to even touch.

description: A hard shell covered in shining gold scales. As gorgeous as a gold bar.

description: Darker than normal Gold Rathian scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

description: Hide that is highly resistant to Water. Don't expect it to sell for much.

name: Spongy Hide+
description: High-grade elastic hide that boasts a remarkable ability to retain water.

description: A small scale that enables graceful movement. Several needed to forge equipment.

name: R.Ludroth Scale+
description: A large, strong scale from a Royal Ludroth. It reflects light in every direction.

name: R.Ludroth Claw
description: A claw from a Royal Ludroth. Adapted better to movement than to attacking.

name: R.Ludroth Claw+
description: A sharp, pointed Royal Ludroth claw. It plunges deep into the earth with each step taken.

name: R.Ludroth Crest

name: R.Ludroth Crest+
description: A proud, strong crest befitting a pack leader. Its sharp horns shine magnificently.

description: The finned tail of a Royal Ludroth, used by fishermen for their boats.

name: Hyper R.Ludroth Scale
description: Darker than normal R.Ludroth scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Seltas Carapace
description: A hard piece of exoskeleton whose smooth surface reduces air resistance while flying.

name: Seltas Innerwing
description: A vital organ for the flying Seltas. In high demand as a household material.

name: Seltas Horn+
description: A sharp horn popular with artisans because, frankly, it's pretty deadly as is.

name: S.Queen Carapace
description: A hard piece of exoskeleton that once made a Seltas Queen a veritable fortress.

name: S.Queen Hardpectus
description: A hard shell from the chest. Its non-slip surface exists so males can mount easily.

name: S.Queen Sharpclaw
description: A claw with a non-slip coating. Used mostly for movement and tunneling.

description: A fluid that circulates through the body. Acidifies when it touches the air.

description: Darker than normal S.Queen shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

description: A dangerous scale that opens at the tip to viscerally attack the beast's foes.

description: A fragment from a Seregios's Airblade. Despite its small size, it shouldn't be underestimated.

name: Seregios Airblade
description: A blade shot from the body and carried on the wind toward unsuspecting hunters.

name: Seregios Carver
description: Hooked hindleg talons that tear through armor and flesh without mercy.

name: Seregios Impaler
description: A spear-like tail covered in blade-like scales. Capable of truly horrific things.

name: Seregios Breacher
description: A sharp horn like a hefty axe that, not surprisingly, makes for fine equipment..

name: Seregios Wingtalon
description: A talon that grows on the wing of a Seregios. Enables superior flight and handling capabilities.

name: Seregios Scraper
description: A wing talon. Most attacks come from the hindlegs; the wings serve to shift weight.

name: Seregios Dissenter
description: A single scale that points defiantly in a different direction from its brethren.

name: Hyper Seregios Scale
description: Darker than normal Seregios scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Ceanataur Shell
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur Shell. Has a distinctive color and shape.

name: Ceanataur Carapace
description: Harder than a Ceanataur Shell, this carapace is harder to work with.

name: Ceanataur Leg
description: A Shogun Ceanataur leg. Incredibly strong to support the beast's massive body.

name: Ceanataur Leg+
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur leg. Extremely strong to support the beast's massive body.

name: Ceanataur Claw
description: A giant Shogun Ceanataur claw. Those who fall in this path pay a dear price.

name: Ceanataur Claw+
description: The sharp claw of a giant Shogun Ceanataur. It's a true menace to hunters.

name: Hyper Ceanataur Shell
description: Darker than normal Ceanataur shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Mizutsune Scale

name: Mizutsune Scale+
description: A quality Mizutsune scale. Older scales polished over time can be very valuable.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur
description: The purple fur of a Mizutsune. Stiff, but is soft as silk when soaked with bubblefoam.

name: Mizutsune Purplefur+
description: High-quality purple fur. More foam-absorbent than its lighter counterpart.

name: Mizutsune Claw
description: A claw that flies freely through bubblefoam, allowing it to be used as a spike.

name: Mizutsune Claw+
description: Friction-reducing bubblefoam helps this deadly claw slice through prey like sushi.

name: Mizutsune Fin

name: Mizutsune Fin+
description: A high-quality fin. Bubble-foam gives it an elegant pattern prettier than dye.

name: Mizutsune Tail

name: Bubblefoam

name: Bubblefoam+
description: The top layer of a Mizutsune's fluid. It removes impurities and is used in religious rituals.

name: Mizutsune Plate
description: A very old scale present since the creature's birth. It can even create a rainbow from light.

name: Mizutsune Water Orb
description: A multicolored orb formed from a crystalized Mizutsune scale and bubblefoam.

name: Hyper Mizutsune Scale
description: Darker than normal Mizutsune scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Tetsucabra Scale
description: A scale with red and black patches that blends in well with cavern environments.

name: Tetsucabra Scale+
description: A fine red-and-black scale. The top pick for artisans who want the time-hardened best.

name: Tetsucabra Shell
description: A flexible yet hard rubber-like shell. In high demand as an armor forging material.

name: Tetsucabra Carapace
description: A flexible, highly durable shell that makes comfortable and easy-to-move-in armor.

name: Tetsucabra Claw
description: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Short, but worth the effort to obtain.

name: Tetsucabra Claw+
description: A powerful claw that can pulverize rock. Creates scratch-proof equipment.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks
description: A giant, shovel-like jaw, complete with tusks used for attacking and movement.

name: Tetsucabra Tusks+
description: A jaw with oversized tusks. Recent finds reveal damaged tusks grow back even harder.

name: Dignified Skull
description: A distinctly warped skull that is far more durable than normal bone.

name: Paddock Oil
description: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Used at the Smithy as a lubricant and additive.

name: Paddock Oil+
description: A mysterious oil found only in nature. Purer oil yields higher forge temperatures.

name: Hyper Tetsu Scale
description: Darker than normal Tetsucabra scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Drilltusk Scale
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra scale. It's hard and features a unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Scale+
description: A hard scale of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. It's sharp and features a unique pattern.

name: Drilltusk Shell
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra shell. It's quite hard and has a unique red and blue pattern.

name: Drilltusk Carapace
description: A Drilltusk Tetsucabra carapace. Its thickness makes it quite hard.

name: Drilltusk Tusk
description: The tusk of a Drilltusk Tetsucabra. Used to dig up large boulders.

name: Drilltusk Tusk+
description: A massive Drilltusk Tetsucabra tusk. An extension of its jaw and its brutality.

name: Tigrex Scale

description: A flawless Tigrex scale. Can be fastened with others to become harder than steel.

name: Tigrex Shell

name: Tigrex Carapace
description: A material hardened by the sands of time. Sharp edges show the Tigrex's ferocity.

name: Tigrex Tail
description: This flexible and strong tail can make great equipment.

name: Tigrex Claw+
description: A claw that time has sharpened into a horrible death sentence for prey.

name: Tigrex Fang
description: A terrifying fang used to crush prey. Makes all who see it quiver in fear.

name: Tigrex Fang+
description: The sharp fang of a Tigrex. These fangs can cut any prey to shreds.

name: Tigrex Scalp
description: Part of the head of a violent Tigrex. Looks terrifying, as if it is still alive.

name: Tigrex Maw
description: The awe-inspiring jaws of a Tigrex, ready to crush both bone and spirit.

name: Hyper Tigrex Scale
description: Darker than normal Tigrex scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Grimclaw Scale
description: A Grimclaw Tigrex scale. Dark and thickly layered. Features exceptional hardness.

name: Grimclaw Scale+
description: A superior Grimclaw Tigrex scale. A scale of the highest quality.

name: Grimclaw Shell
description: A Grimclaw Tigrex shell. You can see the thick blue blood vessels pulsating on its exterior.

name: Grimclaw Carapace
description: You can see the blue blood vessels pulsating on the exterior of the shell.

name: Grimclaw Talon
description: A talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.

name: Grimclaw Talon+
description: A quality talon from a Grimclaw Tigrex. It's as frightening and deadly as it looks.

name: Wyvern Crystal
description: A mysterious crystal that glows with the energy of both light and dark spirits.

name: Ukanlos Carapace
description: The minerals encrusted in this cold-infused shell make it surprisingly strong.

name: Ukanlos Underscale
description: A thick, sharp belly scale. Cuts through snow, allowing Ukanlos to move easier.

name: Ukanlos Digger
description: An Ukanlos claw. Repeated voyages through the ice have twisted its shape.

name: Ukanlos Fin+
description: A huge dorsal fin with saw-like ridges at the tip that cut through anything.

name: Ukanlos Tail
description: The icy tail of Ukanlos. A single lash makes the air scream and the earth cry.

name: Ukanlos Shoveljaw
description: Ukanlos's shovel-like jaw. Developed to shovel snow, one scoop can cause an avalanche.

description: A gem owned by a king who nearly ended the world. It seeks to destroy new owners.

name: Uragaan Scale
description: A hardened scale composed of ore that gives off a faint glow when exposed to light.

name: Uragaan Scale+
description: A strong scale formed by layers and layers of ore. Its hardness makes forging tricky.

name: Uragaan Shell
description: This strong, sturdy piece of exoskeleton makes armor that looks dull but works great.

name: Uragaan Carapace
description: A hard Uragaan carapace. Its rigidity makes it quite a challenge to remove.

name: Uragaan Jaw
description: A crooked Uragaan jaw. Coated with melted minerals that have hardened over time.

name: Uragaan Scute
description: Even more heat resistant than the Shell, this is said to protect sensitive organs.

name: Uragaan Marrow
description: Hard-to-obtain bone marrow used for special crafts as well as medicinal purposes.

description: Darker than normal Uragaan scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Velocidrome Claw+
description: The sharp claw of a Velocidrome. It can easily slice through prey.

name: Velocidrome Head
description: A large head with a crest. You'd look pretty fierce if you put it on.

description: A valuable gem that can be harvested from Jaggi and other bird wyverns.

name: Volvidon Carapace
description: A thick Volvidon carapace. Extra elasticity means extreme pressure is required to forge it.

name: Volvidon Claw
description: A claw from a Volvidon's forelegs. Dramatically increases the power of a wide swing.

name: Volvidon Claw+
description: A hard, sharp Volvidon claw. Constant exposure to heat has tempered it like steel.

description: Superior Garuga scale. Looks like a Kut-Ku scale, but it's much tougher.

description: A rare item, also in great demand as a research material.

name: Garuga Carapace
description: Garuga Shell that's become strong over the years. Great skill is needed to work.

name: Garuga Ear
description: Its shape and form show a different evolutionary path than Yian Kut-Ku.

description: Well-developed Garuga Ear. It's said to heighten one's senses when crafted into armor.

description: The sharpened beak of a Yian Garuga. Looks fiercer than that of a Kut-Ku.

name: Garuga Wing
description: A first class material that requires high crafting skills to work with.

name: Garuga Tail
description: The tail of a Yian Garuga. Responds to shocks by spouting a powerful venom.

name: Garuga Mane
description: Mane from a Yian Garuga. Unusually intimidating.

name: Hyper Garuga Scale
description: Darker than normal Garuga scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Deadeye Scale
description: A scale taken from a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Scale+
description: A hardened scale of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Shell
description: The shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Deadeye Carapace
description: A hardened shell of a Deadeye Yian Garuga. Bears the scars of many hard-fought battles.

name: Kut-Ku Scale
description: Pink scale from a Kut-Ku. Fire resistant. Can be found in the field.

name: Kut-Ku Scale+
description: Superior scale from a Kut-Ku. Its size and weight make it look classier than normal.

name: Kut-Ku Shell
description: The Fire-resistant shell of a Kut-Ku.

name: Kut-Ku Carapace
description: Harder than Kut-Ku Shell, this material is also known as Gravite.

name: Kut-Ku Ear
description: The Fire-resistant ear of a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent Bowguns backfiring.

name: Kut-Ku Auricle
description: A Kut-Ku's Fire-resistant ear. The flexible material is a good base for armor.

name: Giant Beak
description: The huge, sturdy beak of a Yian Kut-Ku.

name: Splendid Beak

description: Webbing from a Kut-Ku wing. Better than animal skin as a fusing material.

name: Hyper Kut-Ku Scale
description: Darker than normal Kut-Ku scales, this Hyper scale emits an ominous glow.

name: Zamtrios Scale+

name: Zamtrios Fin+
description: A quality dorsal fin that's in high demand. Big fins go for a premium at market

name: Hyper Zamtrios Hide
description: Darker than normal Zamtrios hide, this Hyper hide emits an ominous glow.

name: Zinogre Carapace
description: The teal carapace of a Zinogre. Its magnificence reveals the futility of facing the monarch.

name: Zinogre Shockfur
description: White fur that stores and magnifies electricity, which it retains even after carving.

name: Zinogre Electrofur
description: Zinogre fur said to store a high amount of electricity. Shines white from the charge.

name: Zinogre Horn
description: The Zinogre's magnificent horn, which sends most of nature running for cover.

name: Zinogre Horn+
description: A pointed Zinogre horn. When carved, it can be used to grant equipment incomparable power.

name: Zinogre Claw
description: A sharp and tremendously powerful claw capable of quickly dicing up prey.

name: Zinogre Claw+

name: Zinogre Tail
description: The plate-covered tail of a Zinogre. It wields deadly force when swung.

name: Zinogre Shocker
description: The ocher shell that once lined a Zinogre's body. Contains conductive lipids.

name: Zinogre Shocker+
description: A Zinogre shell that stores and releases electricity. Grants a thunder god's power to gear.

name: Zinogre Plate
description: A rare and intimidating trophy that seems to pulse with residual fury.

name: Zinogre Jasper
description: A rare gem sometimes produced inside a Zinogre's body. The monarch's power swells within.

name: Hyper Zinogre Shell
description: Darker than normal Zinogre shell, this Hyper shell emits an ominous glow.

name: Thunderlord Shell
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Carapace
description: A hardened Thunderlord Zinogre shell. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Shockfur
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Electrofur
description: A gold Thunderlord Zinogre pelt. Even on its own, it continues to give off electricity.

name: Thunderlord Horn
description: A Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Thunderlord Horn+
description: A fine Thunderlord Zinogre horn. Even on its own, it shines a brilliant gold.

name: Alatreon Scute
description: A unique plating that can protect against attacks, and even deflect blows.

name: Alatreon Plate
description: This particular Alatreon scale grows in backwards. It is as sharp as a blade.

name: Alatreon Talon
description: A talon capable of making weapons of untold power. Ridiculously sharp.

name: Alatreon Webbing
description: At times this looks like a dark abyss; at others, like the coming of first light.

name: Alatreon Tail
description: The tail from an Alatreon, previously thought to only have existed in legend.

name: Brkn Skypiercer
description: A piece of the horn from atop an Alatreon's head. Broken due to the difficulty harvesting it.

name: Skypiercer
description: Part of an Alatreon's convoluted horns.

name: Azure Dragongem
description: The legend to beat all legends. It is said to bring about the end of those who obtain it.

name: Amatsu Carapace
description: Black armor beaten by fierce winds into powerful defense for a celestial god.

name: Amatsu Webbing
description: Ethereal robes that make one appear to float, like something out of a fable.

name: Amatsu Horn
description: A horn carved from an Amatsu. The unblemished horns are proof of its strength.

name: Amatsu Claw+
description: The incredibly sharp claw of an Amatsu. Just seeing the claw will instill fear of its owner.

name: Amatsu Tail
description: The tail of the Storm Dragon. It is very tough, which helps maneuverability in the storm.

name: Amatsu Pleura
description: A chestplate that is said to steal the future of those who bathe in its passionate light.

name: Storm Vesicle
description: Unique organ that stores large amounts of water. Even a sliver can power up your gear.

name: Heavenly Dragongem
description: The root of the celestial gods' power. It grants their far-reaching vision.

name: Elder Dragon Blood
description: Contains an unknown ingredient, the object of much scholarly research.

name: Chameleos Hide
description: This hide is so strange to the touch, you'll want to rub it all over your face.

name: Chameleos Hide+
description: Superior hide of Chameleos. Strange to the touch, but very durable.

name: Chameleos Horn
description: Faintly glows with a white light. Great for interior decorating.

name: Chameleos Spike
description: A sharp horn of a Chameleos. Strong and hard, but strangely easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Claw
description: Thin, yet incredibly strong and very easy to work with during crafting.

name: Chameleos Claw+
description: Sharpened claw of a Chameleos. Small and sharp, but still valued for being easy to work with.

name: Chameleos Webbing
description: Thin, light wing webbing. The inner part of the webbing is highly durable.

name: Chameleos Tail
description: The distinctive tail of Chameleos. Feels very strange.

name: Chameleos Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside Chameleos. It has a multi-colored glow.

name: Kirin Hide
description: A rare and lovely hide, but difficult to carve loose and dangerous to handle.

name: Kirin Hide+
description: A rare and lovely hide. This one is undamaged: proof of its former owner's strength.

name: Kirin Mane
description: A rare, dashing mane that retains its dignity even after being cut free.

name: Kirin Thundertail
description: A rare tail, overflowing with elegance, charged with electricity.

name: Kirin Thunderhorn
description: The horn of Kirin, as powerful as a lightning bolt. Exquisite material.

name: Kirin Azure Horn
description: An azure horn, rare even among Kirin Horns. Gives off a divine light.

name: Daora Shell
description: The shining silver Kushala Daora shell is solid and highly useful.

name: Daora Carapace
description: A shell hardened by time. Crafting it is incredibly difficult.

name: Daora Scale
description: A scale that glows a dull silver. Hard enough to serve as an abrasive for weapons.

name: Daora Dragon Scale+
description: High-quality scale from Kushala Daora. It is said to surpass steel.

name: Daora Webbing
description: Hard to craft but highly compatible with metals. Valued for its light weight.

name: Daora Horn
description: The gallant horn of Daora. Using it requires extra-ordinary experience.

name: Daora Horn+
description: A fierce-looking horn that instantly robs the body of cold if handled improperly.

name: Daora Tail
description: Cut from Kushala Daora. Incredibly destructive power contained within.

name: Daora Claw
description: Kushala Daora's claw. As hard as ore, it cannot be used by ordinary crafters.

name: Daora Claw+
description: Even now the black gleam of this claw seems to emit a life force.

name: Daora Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside a Daora. Its glow is breathtaking.

name: Nakarkos Husk
description: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Used for crafting, but not much else is known.

name: Nakarkos Husk+
description: Bones that have become hardened somehow due to the fluid of a Nakarkos.

name: Nakarkos Shell
description: The outer shell covering the Nakarkos. Its properties make for great armor.

name: Nakarkos Shell+
description: A spiny outer shell, it has undergone many changes overtime, making it quite unique.

name: Nakarkos Skull
description: A horrifying skull that strikes fear into the hearts of all who see it.

name: Nakarkos Vertabra
description: The sound of this bone terrifies all who hear it. Surprisingly easy to work with.

name: Nakarkos Hide
description: The beautiful blue hide of a Nakarkos. It is hard to tear despite its elasticity.

name: Nakarkos Arm Brace
description: A keratinized brace from the oral arm of a Nakarkos. Hard and oozing a strong adhesive.

name: Nakarkos Fang
description: One of countless fangs in the mouth of a Nakarkos. It can crunch through bone with ease.

name: Nakarkos Cuttlebone
description: A small white bone that is found inside the body of a Nakarkos.

name: Nakarkos Soul Orb
description: A jewel formed in a Nakarkos from the remains of the endless prey it has devoured.

name: Radiant Mucus
description: A viscous liquid produced by the Nakarkos. It gives off an ominous glow.

name: Radiant Mucus+
description: Nakarkos mucus is said to help prevent the deterioration of bone materials.

name: S.Magala Scale
description: A shining scale just shy of blinding white. Dignified, like an ancient dragon.

name: S.Magala Scale+
description: A golden-white scale whose light stays with the eye through a thousand nights.

name: S.Magala Shell
description: A layered shell from which scratches seem to disappear before one's very eyes.

name: S.Magala Carapace
description: Celestial armor the Shagaru Magala once wore: an impervious font of light.

name: S.Magala Prismwing
description: A newly grown wing whose seemingly airy membranes belie rock-like strength.

name: S.Magala Prismwing+
description: A wing that casts iridescent light in the sun. Thinner wings sell at higher prices.

name: S.Magala Caress
description: A claw with a mystic shimmer that hardens with age. Used like a tree's growth rings.

name: S.Magala Caress+
description: A tender claw that hardens only in the face of danger, then kills softly.

name: S.Magala Tail
description: A white tail whose sheer muscularity is concealed by a coat of bristly scales.

name: S.Magala Plate
description: A back scale claimed only by hunters who stand beneath the beast's wings and survive.

name: S.Magala Phosgem
description: A pure jewel of light that ignites the skies and eradicates all darkness.

name: S.Magala Horn
description: A hardened sensory organ. The Frenzy's madness is still locked inside.

name: S.Magala Horn+
description: A heroic arch whose hues have been changed; even now the Frenzy pollutes it.

name: Pure Scale
description: A scale of forbidden white whose complete lack of impurities is truly rare.

name: Teostra Shell
description: The red hot shell of Teostra. It proves its domain over all fire.

name: Teostra Carapace
description: Harder than Teostra Shell. Looks like red-hot steel; particularly eye catching.

name: Teostra Mane
description: This majestic mane is a sure sign of Teostra's regality.

name: Teostra Tail
description: Covered in red scales, the tree like tail of Teostra is incredibly hard to cut.

name: Teostra Horn
description: A horn that displays the power of Teostra. Hunters wither before its might.

name: Teostra Horn+
description: A sharp horn that burns with the fury of Teostra. It is tinged with fire.

name: Fire Dragon Scale
description: A scalding hot scale. It'll take your fingerprints right off.

name: Fire Dragon Scale+
description: A scale from a majestic fire dragon. It burns with hot fire from within.

name: Fire Dragon Claw
description: A sharp, glowing Fire Dragon claw. Hard even for experts to craft.

name: Teostra Claw+
description: A death sentence to he who tries to elude the dragon's flames. Still feels hot.

name: Teostra Webbing
description: Wing webbing carved from a fire dragon. A marvelous material with many uses.

name: Teostra Powder
description: Powder from fire dragon wings. Said to magnify a material's abilities.

name: Teostra Gem
description: A rare gem formed inside a fire dragon. Flickers with ferocious flames.
